author: KEXP
description: Through alt-pop anthems, siblings Elizabeth and Hugo Valdivieso come together as the musical project Valgur to explore worlds of magical realism and science fiction. With host Albina Cabrera, the Mexico City-based duo share a performance of "Máscara de Niña" and more.
title: Valgur performs "Máscara de Niña" & more Live on KEXP

author: KEXP
